name: FLEX Member Enrollment Dashboard
description: FLEX member enrollment by Group (A-F) and employer: progress, members still to complete, defaults, daily completions on a fixed calendar axis, and an employer detail card with plan selections that appears when one employer is selected in an Input Control. Binds to the existing row-level Member Enrollment detail model and keeps only FLEX rows (Wave 'Group A'-'Group F').

feeds.description: Existing row-level model AM_MEMBER_ENROLLMENT_DETAIL (same model as sac-member-detail-widget). Add these 14 dimensions in EXACTLY this order, AFTER the measures: Member, Wave, Enrollment_Status, Defaulted, Defaulted_Timing, Membership_Type, Member_Health_Coverage, Vision_Plan, Set_Up_Date, Completed_Date, Abandoned_Date, Is_Portico_Employee, EventDate, Employer. The first 13 match the Detail widget's order; Employer is added last. SAC binds by position, not name. The widget keeps only FLEX rows (Wave 'Group A'..'Group F'), excludes Is_Portico_Employee = 'Yes', and uses the latest EventDate.

Add these 9 measures FIRST, in EXACTLY this order: Total_Attempts, HSA_Election_Amount, FSA_Health_Election_Amount, FSA_Dependent_Election_Amount, SuppLife_Member_Amount, SuppLife_Spouse_Amount, SuppLife_Dependent_Amount, Retirement_Pretax_Amount, Retirement_Roth_Amount. This is the same order as the Detail widget.

refresh.description: Re-renders the dashboard from the currently bound data
